decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot builds directly on the firm's in-house formwork, control and automation know-how, so it can interpret early results and refine the product within its core automated precast strategy.

Automatic de-shuttering sits close to the firm's existing circulation-plant and formwork expertise, so it is an extension of known technology that can be sold as a modular option alongside the combined robot.

The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots in an integrated automated line and draws on the firm's handling, planning and control capabilities, so it fits the firm's absorptive strengths.

The automatic shuttering robot leverages the firm's deep shuttering and control knowledge and research experience, letting the firm learn from customer installations and improve it rather than abandon it.
